question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

My sister bought the ______ watch.
solution:
The correct answer is 'antique'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• antipathy - It is a **noun **which means a deep-seated feeling of aversion.
 
• colloquial - It is an **adjective **which means (of language) used in ordinary or familiar conversation; not formal or literary.
 
• antilocal - It is an **adjective **which means opposing what is local.
 
• antique - It is an **adjective **which means having a high value because of age and quality.
 
 
 
• The given blank needs an **adjective **to describe the type of watch that was bought. 
 
• Hence, antique is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. 
 
• So, option 4 is the correct answer. 

Correct sentence__ - *My sister bought the **__antique__ **watch.*
